description: Sony PlayStation DirectSound SPU (sound) plugin for PSEmu Pro compatible emulators (P.E.Op.S. DSound)
notes: This is a 32-bit SPU plugin DLL, not a standalone emulator.
Copy spuPeopsDSound.dll from $dir into your emulator's plugins folder (ePSXe, PCSX, etc.) and select it as the sound plugin.
This plugin is no longer developed.
